CAN_ADMIN_KEY.description: PutKeyPolicy or CreateGrant (can grant itself decrypt); ScheduleKeyDeletion.

CAN_ADMIN_MSG.description: Change the topic or queue attributes or policy.

CAN_ASSUME_WEB_IDENTITY.description: AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity admitted by the trust policy; props.admits = any | pattern | specific.

CAN_DECRYPT.description: kms:Decrypt (key-policy-first evaluation). GenerateDataKey* alone is CAN_ENCRYPT.

CAN_EXEC.description: Interactive execution inside running compute: ecs:ExecuteCommand, SageMaker presigned notebook or domain URLs.

CAN_HIJACK.description: A complete existing-resource chain (update plus run, with PassRole where needed) gives code execution as the resource's role.

CAN_INVOKE.description: Invoke only. Never traversable: invoking a function does not give its role.

CAN_MODIFY.description: Some compute-modifying action without a complete chain to code execution.

CAN_PASS_ROLE_TO.description: PassRole plus a service action that runs code as the passed role (new-passrole / existing-passrole rules); evidence.via lists the services, evidence.rule_ids the rules.

CAN_READ_SECRET.description: secretsmanager:GetSecretValue (BatchGet only with it). Metadata actions give no edge.

CAN_READ_TABLE.description: Read items, including PartiQL select and exports.

CAN_UPDATE_CODE.description: lambda:UpdateFunctionCode: code execution as the execution role.

DDB_GRANTS_CROSS_ACCOUNT.description: The table's resource policy grants another account. Normalised grantee → table.

DDB_GRANTS_PUBLIC.description: The table's resource policy grants everyone. Normalised anonymous → table.

EBS_SHARED_CROSS_ACCOUNT.description: createVolumePermission for another account. Normalised account → snapshot.

ECR_GRANTS_CROSS_ACCOUNT.description: The repository policy grants another account (pull or push). Normalised grantee → repository.

ECR_GRANTS_PUBLIC.description: The repository policy grants everyone. Normalised anonymous → repository.

ENCRYPTED_BY.description: Default bucket encryption key (resolved KMS id).

FRONTS.description: Internal load balancer forwards to the target.

HAS_POLICY.description: Managed policy attached to the principal (ARN-keyed).

INVOKES.description: API route proxies to the (unqualified) function.

KMS_GRANT.description: A KMS grant whose operations include a decrypt-capable operation (grantee → key).

KMS_GRANTS_CROSS_ACCOUNT.description: The key policy grants another account. Normalised grantee → key.

LAMBDA_GRANTS_CROSS_ACCOUNT.description: The function policy lets another account invoke it. Normalised grantee → function.

LAMBDA_GRANTS_INVOKE.description: The function policy lets a same-account principal or service invoke it. Normalised grantee → function.

LAMBDA_GRANTS_PUBLIC.description: Public invoke (function policy or NONE-auth URL). Normalised anonymous → function.

MSG_GRANTS_CROSS_ACCOUNT.description: The topic or queue policy grants another account. Normalised grantee → resource.

MSG_GRANTS_PUBLIC.description: The topic or queue policy grants everyone. Normalised anonymous → resource.

PUBLIC_INBOUND.description: Reachable from the internet (security groups, routes, NACLs, scheme, endpoint access). INTERNET_FACING is folded into props.igw_routed.

SECRET_ENCRYPTED_BY.description: The secret's KMS key (default aws/secretsmanager resolved).

SECRET_GRANTS_CROSS_ACCOUNT.description: The secret's resource policy grants another account. Normalised grantee → secret.

SECRET_GRANTS_PUBLIC.description: The secret's resource policy grants everyone. Normalised anonymous → secret.

SERVICE_CAN_ASSUME.description: The trust policy admits an AWS service principal (PassRole candidates, confused-deputy checks).

USES_ROLE.description: The compute resource runs as the role (Lambda execution role, ECS task role, stack service role, job role). The ECS execution role is EXECUTION_ROLE.

evaluation_gaps.detail: APIs without per-method/route authorisation data (old report or a failed call): unauthenticated routes cannot be listed.
The report predates _coverage.json: denied or failed collection cannot be told apart from empty data.
Identity policies of external principals are not visible; cross-account edges are conditional.
IAM was collected with the per-entity (d13c215) layout: no policy versions, no identity providers, boundaries and tags may be missing
Resource control policies are unknown (membership unknown)
Service control policies are unknown (membership unknown)
Condition values known only at request time (source IP, MFA, tags in the request) are not evaluated; such decisions are conditional.
Session policies passed at AssumeRole time can only narrow permissions and are not modelled.

findings.description: The dynamodb table's resource policy grants dynamodb:Query to any AWS principal.
findings.remediation: Scope the Principal or add Condition constraints (e.g. aws:PrincipalOrgID).
findings.title: DynamoDB table 'demo-open-table' is accessible to everyone through its resource policy

findings.description: The ecr repository's resource policy grants ecr:BatchGetImage to any AWS principal.
findings.remediation: Scope the Principal or add Condition constraints (e.g. aws:PrincipalOrgID).
findings.title: ECR repository 'demo-public-repo' is accessible to everyone through its resource policy

findings.description: A policy of the function lets any caller perform lambda:invokefunction.
findings.remediation: Scope the Principal, or add a SourceArn/SourceAccount Condition.
findings.title: Lambda 'demo-public-fn' grants public access via its resource policy

findings.description: The function URL needs no authentication and the function policy lets unauthenticated callers invoke it: anyone on the internet can run the function.
findings.remediation: Set the function URL AuthType to AWS_IAM, or remove the public InvokeFunctionUrl permission and the URL if it is not needed.
findings.title: Lambda 'demo-public-fn' has a public function URL (AuthType NONE)

findings.description: The SQS policy lets any principal perform sqs:sendmessage.
findings.remediation: Scope the Principal or add a Condition (e.g. aws:SourceArn/SourceAccount).
findings.title: SQS 'demo-queue' grants access to everyone

findings.description: The secret's resource policy grants secretsmanager:GetSecretValue to any AWS principal.
findings.remediation: Remove the wildcard Principal or add a restrictive Condition (aws:PrincipalOrgID, aws:PrincipalAccount).
findings.title: Secret 'demo/api-token' is accessible to everyone through its resource policy

findings.description: This report predates per-method authorisation data: the API has Lambda integrations and no authorizer object, so its routes may be unauthenticated (AWS_IAM methods need no authorizer object; re-collect to decide per route).
findings.remediation: Attach an authorizer (IAM, Cognito, JWT or Lambda) to the listed routes, or confirm that unauthenticated access is intended.
findings.title: API 'demo-http-api' has Lambda integrations and no authorizer object

findings.description: Unrestricted PassRole (can pass any role to any service)
findings.remediation: Restrict to specific actions and resource ARNs
findings.title: Unrestricted PassRole (can pass any role to any service)

findings.description: The dynamodb table's resource policy grants dynamodb:GetItem to principals of account(s) 999999999999, independently of this account's IAM policies.
findings.remediation: Verify cross-account access is intended.
findings.title: DynamoDB table 'demo-table' is shared with 999999999999

findings.description: Account 111122223333 can create volumes from the snapshot (createVolumePermission).
findings.remediation: Verify the cross-account sharing is intended.
findings.title: EBS snapshot 'snap-0a1b2c3d4e5f6aaa1' is shared with account 111122223333

findings.description: The ecr repository's resource policy grants ecr:BatchGetImage, ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer to principals of account(s) 111122223333, independently of this account's IAM policies.
findings.remediation: Verify cross-account pull/push access is intended.
findings.title: ECR repository 'demo-repo' is shared with 111122223333

findings.description: The kms key's resource policy grants kms:Decrypt to principals of account(s) 999999999999, independently of this account's IAM policies.
findings.remediation: Verify that cross-account use of the key is intended; remove accounts that should not use it.
findings.title: KMS key 'alias/demo-app' is shared with 999999999999

findings.description: A policy of the function lets arn:aws:iam::111122223333:root (account 111122223333) perform lambda:invokefunction.
findings.remediation: Verify cross-account invoke access is intended.
findings.title: Lambda 'demo-etl' grants access to account 111122223333

findings.description: The SNS policy lets arn:aws:iam::999999999999:root (account 999999999999) perform sns:subscribe.
findings.remediation: Verify cross-account access is intended.
findings.title: SNS 'demo-topic' grants access to account 999999999999

findings.description: SSM parameter '/demo/api_key' has type 'String' (plaintext) but its name has a credential word as a whole token. Anyone with ssm:GetParameter on it reads the value in plaintext, with no KMS gate.
findings.remediation: Migrate the parameter to type SecureString (KMS-encrypted).
findings.title: Parameter '/demo/api_key' looks like a secret but is stored as a plaintext String

findings.description: SSM parameter '/demo/db/password' has type 'String' (plaintext) but its name has a credential word as a whole token. Anyone with ssm:GetParameter on it reads the value in plaintext, with no KMS gate.
findings.remediation: Migrate the parameter to type SecureString (KMS-encrypted).
findings.title: Parameter '/demo/db/password' looks like a secret but is stored as a plaintext String

findings.description: Can create CloudFormation stack with privileged role
findings.remediation: Restrict iam:PassRole and cloudformation:CreateStack
findings.title: PassRole+CloudFormation: Can create CloudFormation stack with privileged role

findings.description: Can run ECS task with privileged role
findings.remediation: Restrict iam:PassRole Resource to specific role ARNs
findings.title: PassRole+ECS: Can run ECS task with privileged role

findings.description: Can create Glue endpoint/job with privileged role
findings.remediation: Restrict iam:PassRole Resource to specific role ARNs
findings.title: PassRole+Glue: Can create Glue endpoint/job with privileged role

findings.description: Can replace the code of an existing Lambda function; the code runs as the function's execution role
findings.remediation: Restrict lambda:UpdateFunctionCode to specific functions whose roles are not more privileged
findings.title: UpdateFunctionCode: Can replace the code of an existing Lambda function; the code runs as the function's execution role

findings.description: Can start an existing CodeBuild project with a buildspec override; the build runs as the project's service role
findings.remediation: Restrict codebuild:StartBuild to specific projects and their service roles
findings.title: StartBuild (buildspec override): Can start an existing CodeBuild project with a buildspec override; the build runs as the project's service role

findings.description: Can take over an existing CloudFormation stack with a service role and run code or API calls as the role it runs as
findings.remediation: Restrict stack updates and change sets on stacks with privileged service roles; use a service role scoped to the stack's resources
findings.title: CloudFormation stack update: Can take over an existing CloudFormation stack with a service role and run code or API calls as the role it runs as

findings.description: Can take over an existing SageMaker notebook instance and run code or API calls as the role it runs as
findings.remediation: Restrict sagemaker:CreatePresignedNotebookInstanceUrl to the notebook's owners
findings.title: SageMaker presigned notebook URL: Can take over an existing SageMaker notebook instance and run code or API calls as the role it runs as

findings.description: The secret's resource policy grants secretsmanager:GetSecretValue to principals of account(s) 999999999999, independently of this account's IAM policies.
findings.remediation: Verify that cross-account access to the secret is intended; scope the Principal to specific role ARNs or add aws:PrincipalOrgID.
findings.title: Secret 'demo/db-password' is shared with 999999999999

findings.description: The IAM password policy is below common baselines: password reuse prevention None < 24.
findings.remediation: Set an account password policy: length >= 14, all character classes, reuse prevention 24.
findings.title: The account password policy is weak

findings.description: Record 'www.example.com.' (CNAME) points at 'demo-alb.eu-west-2.elb.amazonaws.com' (elb, takeover unlikely): no load balancer with this DNS name in the analysed regions: a stale record (ELB names carry a random suffix and cannot be re-registered).

evidence.check: no load balancer with this DNS name in the analysed regions: a stale record (ELB names carry a random suffix and cannot be re-registered)

findings.remediation: Verify the target resource still exists and belongs to you; remove the record if not.
findings.title: Potential dangling DNS record: www.example.com.

findings.description: Web identity provider cognito-identity.amazonaws.com can assume 'demo-cognito-auth'.
findings.remediation: Require the provider's audience (<host>:aud) and an exact subject (<host>:sub), e.g. repo:<org>/<repo>:ref:refs/heads/main for GitHub or system:serviceaccount:<ns>:<sa> for EKS.
findings.title: Role 'demo-cognito-auth' trusts cognito identities (specific subjects)

account.description: Anchor for account-wide findings (hygiene, posture, collection gaps).
account.label: Account

account_admin.description: Administrator of the assessed account; the default path target.
account_admin.label: Account administrator

anonymous.description: The internet / any AWS account. Source of every public exposure (F-037).
anonymous.label: Anyone

cognito.description: Hands out role credentials; treated as a bridge (entered only through control edges).
cognito.label: Cognito identity pool

external_principal.description: A specific user, role or session in a foreign account.
external_principal.label: External principal

idp.description: IAM OIDC or SAML provider, or a well-known web identity provider.
idp.label: Identity provider

kms.description: A data gate, not data: CAN_DECRYPT is needed to read encrypted resources.
kms.label: KMS key

lambda.description: Unqualified function; versions and aliases are in props.qualifiers.
lambda.label: Lambda function

service_principal.description: Context only (who may assume a role on behalf of a service).
service_principal.label: AWS service principal

user.description: Long-term credentials: a leaked access key is a common entry point.
user.label: IAM user
